svg.aria-label: Build the builders — a robot-factory still
svg.title: Build the builders — a robot-factory still
svg.desc: Original conceptual pixel art. A large robot studies a blueprint and assembles a smaller builder; its successor makes another robot, and a signal carries lessons back. Satellites orbit a ringed world above a distant, fictional robot battle. A static scene showing all three generations at once. This is a story about self-improvement, not a hardware design or a claim of autonomous physical qualification.
